content.en: Microeconomics focuses on **scarcity**, **choice**, and **opportunity cost**. It examines how individual units—consumers and producers—interact in markets to determine prices and quantities. In the Indian economy, these concepts are vital for understanding how the **Union Budget** or **RBI** policies influence consumer spending and corporate investment decisions.
